parsed.why: Criminalisation with sharia death penalty in some regions, insurgent executions through 2024, regular prosecutions and impunity, total public taboo. No trans protections; outed visitor faces prison or death depending on territory.

Courts recently sentenced 40-plus people to stoning, crucifixion and death; breach-of-modesty laws reach public expression; vigilante licence plus no identifiable activists. Death-penalty state with active judicial targeting outweighs everything else.

Same-sex conduct legal since 1869; courts granted trans gender recognition, employment protection names gender identity, constitution read to cover SOGI. No traveller-facing restriction documented, though daily discrimination and violence persist.

Self-determination recognition, full hate-crime and discrimination coverage, marriage equality, working prosecutions; guide rates it safest for queer travellers. Documented dating-app ambush pattern and harassment temper, but do not dominate, the protective machinery.

Federal gender-identity protections, X markers, identity-based prison placement and provincial recourse. Offset by six-year hate-crime rise, 39% survey-reported violence, and an organised anti-trans movement — hostility at scale despite functioning protections.
